content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-97 establishes that CPT 93271 was bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; peer-to-peer review has already been attempted without payment. There is no correctable claim defect, authorization path, current information request, or valid further appeal on the table. Because a bundled contractual denial is not a proper patient liability, the balance should be closed rather than billed to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
